description: Create a STANDING WANT: keep searching for what the user wants to buy and get notified when a NEW match appears, across sessions. Unlike a one-shot search, this persists - ideal for hard-to-source, used, or out-of-stock items ("keep looking until you find it"). Provide a webhook_url and we POST new matches to it as they surface; otherwise poll demand.list_watches. Same query shape and enforced constraints as demand.search. WITHOUT AN API KEY this works too, under limits: no webhooks, three standing wants at a time, a six-hour minimum re-check, and a seven-day life. Any limit applied to your request comes back in `notes`.

category.description: Broad kind of thing. Defaults to goods; use services for labour.

check_interval_minutes.description: How often to re-check, in minutes (>=5 with a key, >=360 without, default 60). A request below the floor is raised and the change reported in `notes`.

client_token.description: Optional idempotency key (<=128 chars). Retrying with the same token returns the original watch instead of creating a duplicate. (v1.1 §E)

constraints.description: Machine-evaluable constraints (rules.condition_min, rules.specs). Enforced like demand.search.

description.description: Further detail that did not belong in the title: intended use, acceptable substitutes, what is already ruled out.

min_score.description: Only notify on matches at/above this relevance (0..1, default 0.5)

price_cents.description: Budget ceiling in cents. $1,200 is 120000. Enforced as a maximum for the life of the watch, so a wrong ceiling means it can never match.

title.description: What to keep watching for (3-200 chars)

webhook_url.description: https URL we POST new matches to (type: want.matches). Requires an API key - a keyless request naming one is refused rather than silently ignored.

name: demand.create_watch

notes.description: Any limit applied to your request, stated plainly rather than applied silently.

check_interval_minutes.description: How often it actually re-runs, after any clamp.

expires_at.description: When it stops on its own. Keyless watches live 7 days.

webhook_url.description: Null for keyless callers, who poll instead.

webhook_secret.description: Shown once, on first creation only. Signs every delivery.

title: Create a standing want (watch)
